items.title: Bitcoin's 'Uptober' Goes Bust With Worst October Finish Since 2014
items.summary: Bitcoin's celebrated "Uptober" tradition suffered another setback in 2026, with the leading crypto asset closing October down 7.32% against the greenback, its weakest performance for the month since 2014.
